REJECTED — the invariant at work
assign Owned(x) to y → 409
BOOK_ALREADY_ASSIGNED
unassign an Unowned book → 404
unassign Owned(x) as y → 404
both OWNERSHIP_NOT_FOUND
GET owner of Unowned → 404
BOOK_NOT_ASSIGNED
